span: As stated previously, we fix the non-centrality parameters, , and only optimize over due to the fact that our model would be over-specified otherwise. span: Whereas [10] seeks to identify novel risk loci by leveraging functional information, we instead propose our method as way to refine signal at known GWAS loci. This fundamental distinction leads to different statistical models and optimization procedures allowing for superior accuracy for refining association signal through fine-mapping. In addition our method addresses a limitation of [10] by allowing for the possibility of multiple causal variants at a risk locus.
